_readme: Sweater log for the 32 NHL team schedule posts. Read by scripts/gen-nhl-schedule-tables.mjs.
Key = '<YYYY-MM-DD> <AWAY>@<HOME>' using NHL tricodes (game date as the NHL API lists it).
Any side you leave out falls back to the league default: 'Home Dark' for the home team, 'Road White' for the visitor.
Per side: call = text shown in the row, color = optional hex for the call text (thirds), note = internal only.
confirmed: true = we SAW both sweaters (ESPN game photos/highlight frames, team graphic or gallery). Rows render 'Confirmed' in green.
Without confirmed, a row stays 'Expected' (use that for announced specials before the game, e.g. Screaming Eagle nights).
Final scores are NOT stored here: the generator reads them live from the NHL API and prints W/L on every played row.

Grades: every confirmed game gets a letter on its tracker card from matchupGrades (keyed by the sweater pairing, so repeats match). New pairing = add a line there; nhl-tracker-day.mjs warns when a game has none.

Daily pass: node scripts/nhl-game-photos.mjs <YYYYMMDD> (view the frames), add/adjust entries here, then npm run nhl:daily (schedule tables + daily tracker post; /nhl-tracker team pages read this file at build)

matchupGrades._note: Provisional ColorWay letter grades, one per sweater pairing: '<AWAY> <away call> @ <HOME> <home call>' (calls exactly as the tracker card prints them). Same two sweaters, same home/away = same grade every time, so a repeat pairing inherits this automatically. Jake adjusts here. Standard home dark vs road white sits around B; classic sets, strong contrast, color-vs-color or a good alternate can go higher. A per-game "grade" in games overrides.
